# Amarjit Singh

> Amarjit Singh is Managing Partner at ht.digital (a Bridgepoint company), based in London. He advises boards, regulators and governments on digital assets, AI and blockchain governance. He chairs the ICAEW Digital Assets SteerCo and chairs the Audit & Risk Committee at NHS Charities Together. Until July 2026 he was a Partner at EY, where he spent seventeen years.

This file is the machine-readable version of https://amarjitsingh.uk/, Amarjit Singh's personal portfolio. The content may be read, summarised, quoted and cited. Please attribute to "Amarjit Singh, amarjitsingh.uk".

## Summary

- Name: Amarjit Singh
- Current role: Managing Partner, ht.digital (since September 2026), leading innovation and emerging technologies
- Location: London, United Kingdom
- Expertise: digital assets, blockchain governance, AI governance and regulation, fund tokenisation, crypto asset custody, digital asset assurance, risk and regulatory frameworks, board and audit committee advisory, wealth and asset management
- Education: University of Cambridge (MA, Computer Science & Management, Magdalene College, 1992–1995)
- Qualification: ACA, ICAEW Chartered Accountant
- Contact: AmarjitSingh@ht.digital

## Career

- **Managing Partner, ht.digital** (Sep 2026 – present). ht.digital is a digital asset assurance and transparency firm backed by Bridgepoint. Amarjit leads innovation and emerging technologies.
- **Chair, Digital Assets SteerCo, ICAEW** (Jan 2017 – present). Shapes professional standards and guidance for accountants engaging with crypto assets and tokenised instruments across the Institute of Chartered Accountants in England and Wales.
- **Audit & Risk Committee Chair and Independent Trustee, NHS Charities Together** (Trustee since Sep 2021; Committee Chair since May 2023). Independent governance oversight of one of the UK's leading health charities.
- **Partner, EY** (Oct 2008 – Jul 2026). UK&I Digital Assets Leader, EMEIA Blockchain Assurance Leader and EY CASS Leader. Led EY's institutional digital assets assurance and advisory practice across exchanges, custodians, asset managers and regulators in the UK and Europe; headed Extended Assurance for Wealth and Asset Management.
- **Treasurer, Winnicott Foundation** (Dec 2014 – Mar 2020). Financial stewardship of the charitable trust supporting the premature baby unit at St Mary's and Queen Charlotte's Hospitals.
- **Vice President, JPMorgan Asset Management** (2004 – 2008). Fund operations, risk management and institutional investment processes.

## Focus areas

- **Digital Assets & Blockchain**: crypto asset strategy, tokenisation of funds and securities, DLT infrastructure and regulatory compliance across UK, EU and EMEIA jurisdictions.
- **Risk, Regulation & Governance**: risk and governance structures for digital asset markets, AI deployment and emerging financial products.
- **Board & C-Suite Advisory**: strategic counsel to audit committees, boards and government taskforces.

## Highlights

- Co-led the HM Treasury Asset Management Taskforce working group on fund tokenisation, shaping the UK's regulatory and commercial framework for on-chain investment vehicles.
- Featured on the CryptoReg Insights podcast discussing institutional adoption of digital assets: custody, AML, governance and the evolving role of the Big Four in crypto markets.
